analyst.summary: Manappuram Finance is a gold-loan NBFC with a microfinance subsidiary (Asirvad) that went through a real, sector-wide stress period which dented profits through FY25 and into early FY26, but has shown four consecutive quarters of profit recovery since. The business was recently recapitalized through a large equity investment from Bain Capital, which also took board representation - a meaningful strengthening of the capital base and governance oversight. Given the genuine recovery trend and the new strategic backing, we rate this a Hold rather than a Sell, while flagging it for a closer management-level look given how much has changed at the ownership level.
